output.text: Welcome! To use your vending token, place it on the sensor pad. Wait for a beep and green light—this means it’s ready. Select your item on the touchscreen, then confirm. The token will deduct the cost, and your item will drop. If unsure, tap the help icon or ask staff. Your token is safe and reusable—keep it clean and dry. Enjoy your purchase!
